# Getting help

District AI for Windows is the desktop client for District AI, the AI voice
receptionist from Distronode. Where to go depends on what you are asking about.

- **A question about District AI, the product** (your account, numbers, plans or
  billing): <https://www.distronode.com/support>. This repository is the Windows
  client, not the product desk.
- **Questions, build trouble and ideas** ("how do I", a build from source that
  fails, a feature you would like):
  [this repository's Discussions](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-windows/discussions).
- **A reproducible bug in the app:**
  [this repository's Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-windows/issues),
  with the bug report form. Leave out tokens and anything about the people your
  workspace talks to.
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through
  [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-windows/security/advisories/new),
  or, if you cannot use GitHub, email opensource@distronode.com. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue for one.
